description: Scream Tracker 3.21 by Future Crew, the tracker the S3M module format was made for, running in your browser with its example song.
about: Scream Tracker 3 is Future Crew's music tracker for MS-DOS; the S3M module format was made for it. This is version 3.21, from December 1994, with an example song, ARMANI.S3M.
What you save in it stays in this browser: the Files button can download it, bring in modules of your own, or start over.
credits: Code by Psi; the manual by Edge of Electromotive Force.
terms: Freeware: “you can give it to your friends and distribute it in any way as long as no money is involved.” (ST3.DOC)
accuracy: Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
It saves on Ctrl+W, which some browsers keep for closing the tab: DosKit asks before the page closes.
imageAlt: Scream Tracker 3's pattern editor, running in DosKit
